# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m147/m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP. This release rolls up the entire 4.147.0 preview cycle and lands the v4 breaking changes from the Skia m132→m148 engine jump: variable font support, color font palettes, animated WebP encoding, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. Vulkan, font-resolution and stream-offset behavior changed — read the breaking changes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, loses value-equality** — The Vulkan YCbCr conversion info struct now follows the SkiaSharp `GR` casing convention (`GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` instead of `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo`), and it no longer implements `IEquatable`/`Equals`/`==`/`!=`. Update field/property references to the new type name and replace equality comparisons with manual field checks.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose loses its public setter** — The property is now get-only. Code that assigned it directly must find another way to control dispose behavior (e.g. a constructor option or subclass override).
- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazy default** — `new SKFont().Typeface` is `SKTypeface.Empty` (0 glyphs) rather than resolving to the platform default at draw time, so `MeasureText` now returns 0 for an unconfigured font. Construct with an explicit typeface (`new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`) and detect "unset" via `Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of a null check.
- **new SKPaint().Typeface now returns Default instead of null** — SkiaSharp still seeds a usable default font so text drawing keeps working, but `paint.Typeface == null` no longer detects "no typeface set" — use `Typeface.IsEmpty` or drop the check.
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName never returns null on Android** — All platforms are now consistent: an unmatched family name returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of `null` on Android. For a strict "was it found" check, use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)`, which still returns `null` on no match.
- **SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null** — Default resolution moved to the font manager; behavior is unchanged on macOS/Windows/Linux, and Android API 36+ (previously able to crash) now falls back to `SKTypeface.Empty` instead.
- **SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws on overflow** — The native offset is a 32-bit int; the overload previously truncated large values silently. It now does a checked cast (throwing `OverflowException` out of range) and is marked `[Obsolete]` (CS0618). Call `Move(int)` with an in-range value instead.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls `SK_ABORT` (terminating the process, uncatchable) instead of failing gracefully when a 1.0 instance/device is supplied. Declare `VK_API_VERSION_1_1` on both the `VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion` used to create the instance and on `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` (do not leave either at 0/default). Genuinely 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan and must pick another backend up front.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative drops five interop fields** — `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice` are removed. Delete those assignments; use `fVkExtensions` in place of `fExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` in place of `fFeatures`. There is no replacement for `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice` — Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the backend context.
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed (new Components field)** — A new `Components` field (backed by a new `GRVkYcbcrComponents` struct) changes the struct's layout. Code that manually constructs or marshals this struct must account for the new field.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m147 to m148** — The bundled engine advances from m132 all the way to m148 across this cycle, bringing every upstream fix and feature landed in between, plus multiple rounds of m147 bug-fix merges. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))
- **Variable fonts, color font palettes and legacy font manager restored** — Variable font support is wired through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, SKFont/SKTypeface gain color font palette selection, and the legacy `sk_fontmgr_legacy_create_typeface` entry point returns for downstream compatibility. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **Default typeface resolution moved to the managed layer** — Fixes an Android API 36+ crash (#3693) and lets consumers observe/override default-typeface fallback without a native round-trip. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))

## API Surface

- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream conversion** — SKWebpEncoder can now emit animated WebP from a frame sequence, and SKStream.GetData() converts a seekable stream to SKData without an intermediate byte[] copy. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions on surface-to-surface draws** — New overloads on SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface accept SKSamplingOptions instead of an implicit default filter/mipmap mode. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HBColor struct and missing HarfBuzzSharp wrappers** — Adds a proper HBColor struct matching hb_color_t and fills in wrappers that were missing or mis-named. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Legacy paint text/font APIs promoted from obsolete to compile error** — The pre-v4 text/font-reading members on SKPaint that were obsoleted in v3 are now hard errors, and the remaining legacy paint state-reading APIs are obsoleted — move to SKFont for text/typeface access. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap pixel-span stride and offset corrected** — GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride, and the generic GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) offset overload used Height instead of Width when computing the element offset — both are fixed. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder collected first** — A GC-ordering bug that could crash on finalization when an SKPathBuilder was collected before the SKPath it produced is fixed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers** — Fixes a load failure of the WinUI Projection assembly when referenced from a .NET 9 application. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Android SKGLView blank after MAUI TabBar switch** — The GL surface is now correctly re-attached after the view is re-added to the tree, fixing a blank canvas after switching MAUI TabBar tabs. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how SkiaSharp's native singleton instances are initialized and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Tizen x64/arm64 and Linux Bionic native targets** — Tizen ships x64 and arm64 native builds alongside x86/arm, and Android-hosted Linux (linux-bionic) becomes a first-class native target instead of falling back to the desktop-glibc build. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Apple TFM alignment and WASM floor raised** — Libraries target versioned Apple TFMs (26.0) while apps use unversioned ones, matching current .NET SDK guidance; pre-.NET 8 Emscripten WASM native builds are dropped. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798), [#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — libexpat 2.7.5/2.8.1, libpng 1.6.58, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype 2.14.3 and libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1 all pick up their latest upstream security and bug fixes. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp adds variable-font shaping support and a proper HBColor struct, and the bundled HarfBuzz binding is refreshed to 14.2.0 alongside the v4 engine bump.

Release Candidate 1 fixed the pixel-span stride/offset bugs, promoted legacy paint APIs to errors, merged Chrome m147 bug fixes, and reworked the singleton lifecycle ahead of stable.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

Preview 3 added HBColor and missing HarfBuzzSharp wrappers, enabled TreatWarningsAsErrors across the binding, added SKStream.GetData(), and fixed CI/build chain issues.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, fixed the SKPath finalizer crash, aligned Apple platform TFMs, and updated freetype/zlib.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.1.1...v4.147.0-preview.2.1)
